about: Tries the normal (animated) skills of scene_add_skill in the game: a sword attack on E whose graph runs 250 ms into the swing and which shows a sword in the hand, the raking of the farming sample on Q, a reach of the hand on R. First each is pressed standing still, with screenshots during the animation; then E and Q are pressed while walking, and the position printed four times a second shows whether the skill holds the character in place and for how long. Played on 2026-10-11: all three animations play, the sword shows, every graph reaches the server; standing still, the sword attack carries the character 0.65 m forward and the raking 0.55 m. The walking part of the script taught something else: with the spawn turned 90 degrees the camera turns with it, D no longer walks along x, and the character walked off the edge of the terrain. Prints: SK_READY, SK_GO, SK_CALL <word>, SK_AT x.
